title: Bloom Energy (BE) Valuation In Focus After AI Data Center Deals And Upgraded 2026 Outlook
title_zh: AI 数据中心交易和升级 2026 年展望后，Bloom Energy (BE) 估值成为焦点
summary: Bloom Energy (BE) is back in focus after the AI power race translated into record first quarter revenue, higher 2026 guidance, and fresh data center projects with Oracle and Nebius, even as valuation worries cool recent enthusiasm. See our latest analysis for Bloom Energy.
summary_zh: 在人工智能力量竞赛转化为创纪录的第一季度收入、更高的 2026 年指导以及与 Oracle 和 Nebius 合作的新数据中心项目后，Bloom Energy (BE) 重新成为焦点，尽管估值担忧冷却了最近的热情。请参阅我们对 Bloom Energy 的最新分析。

title: Why MP Materials (MP) Is Down 11.3% After Apple and Pentagon Rare Earth Magnet Deals
title_zh: 为什么苹果和五角大楼稀土磁铁交易后 MP Materials (MP) 下跌 11.3%
summary: In the first quarter of 2026, MP Materials reported US$90.65 million in sales and a net loss of US$7.97 million, while announcing major multi-year partnerships with Apple and the U.S.
summary_zh: 2026年第一季度，MP Materials报告销售额为9065万美元，净亏损797万美元，同时宣布与苹果和美国建立重要的多年合作伙伴关系。

title: Evercore's Kiely, Morgan Stanley's Cheng Talk AI Deals
title_zh: Evercore 的 Kiely 与摩根士丹利的 Cheng Talk AI 交易
summary: Tammy Kiely, senior managing director in technology investment banking at Evercore Inc., and Wally Cheng, Morgan Stanley's head of global technology M&A, discuss the outlook for dealmaking in the artificial intelligence sector. They speak with Dani Burger on ``Bloomberg Deals.''
summary_zh: Evercore Inc. 技术投资银行部高级董事总经理 Tammy Kiely 和摩根士丹利全球技术并购主管 Wally Cheng 讨论了人工智能领域的交易前景。他们与丹尼·伯格就“彭博交易”进行了交谈。

title: A Look At Diversified Energy’s Valuation As Oklahoma Asset Deal With Carlyle Expands Its Portfolio
title_zh: 随着俄克拉荷马州资产交易与凯雷扩大其投资组合，多元化能源的估值一览
summary: Diversified Energy (DEC) has drawn fresh attention after reaching an agreement with Carlyle to acquire additional oil and gas assets in Oklahoma using asset backed financing, while reporting higher first quarter production and reaffirming 2026 output guidance.
summary_zh: 多元化能源公司 (DEC) 与凯雷达成协议，利用资产支持融资收购俄克拉荷马州的更多石油和天然气资产，同时公布第一季度产量增加并重申 2026 年产量指引，引发了新的关注。

title: Target the Red-Hot Spin-Off and Merger Space With These ETFs
title_zh: 通过这些 ETF 瞄准炙手可热的分拆和合并空间
summary: Spin-offs and mergers can lead to major movement for share prices, but accessing these scenarios can be challenging for investors; these ETFs can help.
summary_zh: 分拆和合并可能会导致股价大幅波动，但了解这些情况对投资者来说可能具有挑战性；这些 ETF 可以提供帮助。
